answer: Put Licensed cold storage manager temperature log with cold chain verification at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A vault of doubt is healthy, a ripple of proof is required, and a quartz of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
